name: The Seventh Bride
source:
Juliette was a simple woman who worked at a tavern, until a wealthy older man proposed to her at first sight.

In Azul's castle, Juliette has every comfort she was deprived of before. A large bedroom, soft bed, servants to tend to her every desire, a closet full of gowns already stitched up and waiting for her, gourmet food, and a loving, attentive husband who brings her pleasure she'd never known before.

But there is a secret in Azul's castle, and Juliette's happiness hinges upon it...

[From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/seventh-bride]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朱丽叶是一个在小酒馆工作的简单女人，直到一位富有的年长男人一见钟情地向她求婚。

在阿祖尔的城堡里，朱丽叶得到了她以前所没有的一切安慰。一间大卧室，柔软的床，满足她每一个愿望的仆人，一个装满已经缝好的礼服等待着她的衣柜，美味的食物，还有一个充满爱心、细心的丈夫，给她带来了她以前从未体验过的快乐。

但阿祖尔的城堡里有一个秘密，朱丽叶的幸福取决于它……

[来自[url=https://krispycat.itch.io/seventh-bride]itch.io[/url]]
